question: Which of the following banks revived its special Fixed Deposit (FD) scheme, known as 'Amrit Vrishti,' with a 444-day tenure, effective from 15 April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **State Bank of India (SBI)**, India's largest commercial bank, introduced and revived a specialized retail term deposit scheme named **'Amrit Vrishti'**.
 
• The scheme features a unique tenure of **444 days**, designed to provide a higher interest rate for a specific short-to-medium-term investment horizon.
 
• As per the latest update, the scheme became effective from **15 April 2025**, offering competitive returns in the current financial market.
 
• Under the **Amrit Vrishti** scheme, the **general public** is offered an interest rate of **7.25% per annum**.
 
• **Senior Citizens** are eligible for an additional spread of **50 basis points (0.50%)** over the standard rate, resulting in a yield of **7.75% per annum**.
